citation: Schild M, et al. Mediators Inflamm 2016;2016:4851935
protocol: Bicycle exercise at 80% of VO2max in endurance-trained and untrained individuals; plasma before, directly after and 3 h after; Table 1 prints performance, maximum lactate and HR for both groups
